mapper.insert: insert into pm_payment_event ( id, merchant_id, device_id, device_sequence, client_event_id, platform, direction, amount_minor, currency, event_time, event_time_ms, client_received_at, client_received_at_ms, client_sent_at, client_sent_at_ms, received_at, parse_status, parser_version, matched_rule, fingerprint, notification_key_hash, raw_hash, raw_payload, status, duplicate_status ) values ( #{id}, #{merchantId}, #{deviceId}, #{deviceSequence}, #{clientEventId}, #{platform}, #{direction}, #{amountMinor}, #{currency}, #{eventTime}, #{eventTimeMs}, #{clientReceivedAt}, #{clientReceivedAtMs}, #{clientSentAt}, #{clientSentAtMs}, #{receivedAt}, #{parseStatus}, #{parserVersion}, #{matchedRule}, #{fingerprint}, #{notificationKeyHash}, #{rawHash}, #{rawPayload,typeHandler=org.dromara.payment.mybatis.JsonbStringTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{duplicateStatus} ) on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: select e.* from pm_payment_event e where e.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and e.direction = 'INCOME' and e.amount_minor is not null and e.status in ('RECEIVED', 'REVIEWED', 'CONFLICT') and coalesce(e.duplicate_status, 'NONE') != 'CONFIRMED' and not exists ( select 1 from pm_payment_order o where o.merchant_id = e.merchant_id and o.matched_event_id = e.id and o.id != #{orderId} ) and not exists ( select 1 from pm_payment_transaction t where t.merchant_id = e.merchant_id and t.event_id = e.id and t.order_id is not null and t.order_id != #{orderId} ) order by case when e.platform = #{platform} and e.amount_minor = #{amountMinor} then 0 else 1 end, coalesce(e.event_time, e.received_at) desc, e.id desc limit #{limit}
